r: Was it? I have got used to such things by now.

tobby5_10.m: I think that I'll find Sobby by myself now. Thank you - hope we'll meet again!

tobby.10: On the road to Feygard I have met a boy named Tobby. He is looking for his brother Sobby.
tobby.20: I have promised to help Tobby get past the kobolds to the south.
tobby.21: I have killed the rat in Tobby's garden.
tobby.22: I gave Tobby a loaf of bread for his father.
tobby.23: Tobby has followed me to the beginning of the ravine with the kobolds.
tobby.24: Tobby has made it through the ravine.
tobby.25: Tobby followed me further to the south.
tobby.30: I have attacked poor Tobby, but he ran away. Now he will never find his brother.
tobby.40: We have parted. Tobby was sure now to find his brother.
tobby.50: I have met Tobby again, together with Sobby in the little village in the woods.
